activity_summary: At the Theatre door the eightpence was paid and the carter sent off. Nick asked if the stage was twice the inn's breadth. You had not paced it, and you did not invent the feet. Heminges told you not to look back at the yard, and nobody did. Garnish put the chest under two locks. The nine lines are still at the lodging, and you have not cut any yet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered Nick without a measurement, and left the nine lines uncut.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Paid the eightpence and told the yard not to be looked at.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Turned both locks, and would not copy a joke twice.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Asked the breadth, and did not look back.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Asked after a loft, and was told the stage was dark.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: Named the eightpence at the door.
